newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-SILVA ENSURES QUARTER-FINAL SPOT FOR BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SILVA ENSURES QUARTER-FINAL SPOT FOR BARCELONA.

text.p: Giovanni Silva's 48th minute goal, just 60 seconds after Red Star had taken the lead, was enough to seal the fate of the Belgrade club and put Barcelona into the quarter-finals of the European Cup Winners' Cup on Thursday.
After a routine 3-1 victory in Barcelona two weeks ago, the Spanish club held Red Star to a 1-1 draw before a capacity crowd of 50,000.

Following a disappointing first half, Red Star immediately went on the attack and took the lead after only two minutes when Zoran Jovicic dived to head Zoran Njegus's low cross from the right past goalkeeper Vitor Baia.

But the crowd's jubilation had not even died down when striker Luis Enrique headed the ball down for midfielder Giovanni Silva to drive a powerful shot under the bar to put Barcelona back on level terms.
Red Star continued to attack but without success. Substitute striker Miodrag Pantelic hit the bar and in the 80th minute Baia was forced into another fine save.
Seven Red Star players and one Barcelona player were booked.

Red Star - 1-Zvonko Milojevic, 2-Bratislav Zivkovic, 3-Goran Djorovic, 4-Zoran Njegus, 5-Predrag Stankovic, 7-Perica Ognjenovic, 9-Zoran Jovicic, 15-Darko Ljubojevic, 17-Nenad Vanic, 20-Darko Anic, 24-Goran Boskovic (Miodrag Pantelic 46th).

Barcelona - 1-Vitor Baia, 3-Abelardo Fernandez, 4-Josep Guardiola, 5-Gheorghie Popescu, 8-Hristo Stoichkov, 9-Ronaldo Nazario (Juan Pizzi 80th), 10-Giovanni Silva, 12-Sergi Barjuan, 15-Laurent Blanc, 20-Miguel Nadal, 21-Luis Enrique.
